messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning simultaneous version bumps across repos. API -> v1.12.0, runtime -> v0.14.3, console -> v2.7.0, sdk-js -> v3.4.1, sdk-py -> v2.5.0. Cutoff is EOD PST Wed. Ping here if anything blocks.
raj: LGTM from API side. I have one follow-up on the changelog entry wording, will drop a PR shortly. @sam can you check SDK compatibility with the new /chat param change?
sam: on it. I ran the js sdk e2e against API branch and saw one test fail (message format). I'll open a tiny patch. ETA ~2h.
li: runtime has a perf tweak that's in flight — I'm going to try and land it before cutoff but will hold the bump if it regresses. Anyone relying on exact kv-cache layout? @maya
maya: runtime api change is backwards-compatible for served models but we do change on-disk cache layout. We should add a compat note in release notes and a migration flag in Dedicated. If li needs to hold, we can ship API/console/SDKs and do runtime separately, but prefer same-day.
jordan: console: need the SDK client pin update for the new console routes. I'll prepare a small client bump PR. Also, remind folks to update the version matrix in docs.
release-bot: Reminder — branch cutoff in 36h for coordinated bump window. See <http://go/release-windows|release calendar> :alarm_clock:
raj: changelog PR: #4782 — short bullet about chat param rename + migration note for kv cache. @li if you hold runtime can you add a note to #4782?
li: will add. If runtime landing slips past cutoff, I'll tag runtime as v0.14.3-rc and coordinate a hotfix pipeline.
sam: opened sdk-js PR #339 and sdk-py PR #201. Both small fixes, tests pass locally. pinging for reviews @maya @raj
maya: reviewing now, will merge if green. Also, please include these snippets in the release steps:
```
# tag and push
git tag -a api/v1.12.0 -m "api v1.12.0"
git push origin api/v1.12.0
```
maya: final note — if anyone needs the bump deferred, call it in this thread before cutoff. Otherwise I'll start the release checklist tomorrow morning PST. :rocket:
